body:
Basic cmake run, make, and then make install step tries to install some initial files directly over the existing installed application.

```
Install the project...
-- Install configuration: "Release"
-- Installing: /Applications/ART.app/Contents/Resources/AUTHORS.txt
-- Installing: /Applications/ART.app/Contents/Resources/LICENSE.txt
-- Installing: /Applications/ART.app/Contents/Resources/AboutThisBuild.txt
-- Installing: /Applications/ART.app/Contents/Resources/RELEASE_NOTES.txt
-- Installing: /Applications/ART.app/Contents/Resources/share/man/man1/ART.1
-- Installing: /Applications/ART.app/Contents/Resources/share/camconst.json
-- Installing: /Users/rb/art/build/Release/MacOS/ART
-- Installing: /Users/rb/art/build/Release/MacOS/ART-cli
-- Installing: /Applications/ART.app/Contents/Resources/share/applications/ART.desktop
-- Installing: /Users/rb/art/build/Release/Resources/share/metainfo/us.pixls.art.ART.metainfo.xml
-- Installing: /Users/rb/art/build/Release/Resources/share/icons/hicolor/16x16/apps/ART.png
```
Expected: all the make install step files should be installed under .../build/Release/... etc. not installed over or into previous application bundle installation.
title: in macos, the make install step overwrites /Applications
